description: Junie Agent API v1 runtime, owner-only native login command and managed engine selection.

login.description: Native login instructions and the JetBrains logo for the secondary product reference in settings.

command.description: Shell-quoted command for the current CLI, or empty when absent. No credentials.

junieWordmark.description: Data URL of the original JetBrains Junie wordmark, for display in the login settings only.

engineSelection.description: The selected engine. Empty directory and version make a removal marker.

directory.description: A release directory basename under the managed engine root, or empty.

version.description: The official JetBrains build tag, or empty.

native-login.description: Return the native login command and vendor wordmark to the activating account and Profile.

engineSelection.description: Atomic pointer to the selected managed engine.
